name: Mini SOC Lab — Detection Coverage
description: Detection coverage layer for the Mini SOC Lab portfolio project. Green = detected with documented evidence. Red = identified gap with no current detection rule.

techniques.comment: DETECTED — EventID 4625 with SubStatus 0xC000006A, threshold >5 failures/5 min. Also T1110.001 (Password Guessing) via EventID 4771 Kerberos pre-auth failure. Coverage confidence: Medium.
DETECTED — Password Guessing detected via EventID 4625 SubStatus 0xC000006A. Detection threshold: >5 failures in 5 minutes against a single account.
DETECTED — Email header analysis (SPF/DKIM/DMARC fail), attachment hash matching, sender domain age check via WHOIS. Coverage confidence: Low-Medium.
DETECTED — Spearphishing Attachment: .docm/.xlsm/.lnk/.iso extension detection, SHA256 hash comparison against threat intel feed.
DETECTED — Spearphishing Link: URL redirector detection, recently registered domain check, display text vs href mismatch.

DETECTED — PowerShell: EventID 4104 ScriptBlock logging enabled. Detection pattern: FromBase64String OR Invoke-Expression OR -EncodedCommand in ScriptBlockText. Coverage confidence: Medium (requires ScriptBlock logging GPO).
DETECTED — Obfuscated Files/Information: EventID 4104 combined with Base64/IEX/DownloadString patterns. Detected in conjunction with T1059.001.
GAP — Valid Accounts: No behavioral baseline established for account usage anomalies. Legitimate credentials used maliciously would not trigger any current detection rule.
GAP — Process Injection: No Sysmon or EDR in lab environment. EventID-only detection cannot observe memory injection without kernel-level hooks.
GAP — OS Credential Dumping: No Sysmon Event 10 (lsass access monitoring) configured. LSASS memory reads by unauthorized processes are not detected.
GAP — Remote Desktop Protocol: No correlation rule for EventID 4648 (explicit credentials) + 4624 (logon Type 10) to detect RDP lateral movement from compromised hosts.
GAP — Application Layer Protocol C2: No network traffic analysis or proxy logs in lab environment. HTTP/HTTPS C2 traffic would not be detected.
GAP — Registry Run Keys: No registry change monitoring configured. HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run modifications are not audited.
GAP — Scheduled Task: Task Scheduler event log (Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational) is not reviewed. Malicious scheduled tasks are not detected.
GAP — Data Encrypted for Impact (Ransomware): No file system monitoring for mass encryption behavior. No honeypot files or canary directory configured.
GAP — Exfiltration Over C2 Channel: No DLP tools, no network egress monitoring, no data volume baselining. Exfiltration via established C2 channel is completely undetected.

legendItems.label: Gap — no current detection rule; remediation needed
